comparison.objective: Empty all food scraps from a sink strainer into a caddy and reseat the basket; candidate separates ceramic media from washers using a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift, carry, invert, and empty one perforated basket versus controlled size/orientation-selective passage, bridge clearing, and retention of larger workpieces.
comparison.success_condition: All scraps transferred together and basket reseated, with none entering the drain or spilling, versus media passing through while every washer stays in the screen and ≥98% reaches the receiver.
comparison.reason: This is the closest geometric analogue, but it explicitly empties all contents rather than separating a mixture by aperture compatibility.
